title: ARIA enterprise-ready: on-demand sourcing agents (deer-flow pattern) + Flowise Agent Studio + gated autopilot + multi-tenant + admin dashboard
rescope_reason: Tony merged new /goal (2026-07-09): deer-flow-pattern on-demand sourcing agents, Flowise visual agent-builder section, gated autopilot with candidate reply handling. Explicit re-scoping decision via 5 Socratic questions + 4 clarifiers — NOT outcome drift.
outcome: ARIA runs on-demand, single-task sourcing agents (deer-flow-pattern planner→sourcer→screener→outreach→reporter, fully parameterizable per role/candidate profile, hard guardrails), editable via an embedded Flowise Agent Studio section, with queue-only reply drafting for candidate replies across email + WhatsApp (LinkedIn draft-gated), every outbound message passing a human-likeness gate and named-human approval before dispatch, multi-tenant with admin dashboard, deployed to production.
outcome_criterion: On the deployed production build: two test users (one admin, one regular) each create an on-demand sourcing agent for a different role via the embedded Agent Studio (Flowise) section; each runs a full sourcing cycle with zero code intervention; at least one real outreach email is sent to a Tony-controlled test inbox, the candidate answers back, and the reply-drafting agent queues the generated reply for Tony approval; out-of-guardrail replies are also queued with explicit review reasons. At least one WhatsApp message is sent to a Tony-controlled number via official API and passes the human-likeness gate (zero AI-tell/status/meta messages on the wire); admin dashboard shows both users activity plus efficiency metrics. Verifier: Tony runs acceptance script + manual pass, records PASS/FAIL.
verifier: Tony runs acceptance script + manual pass on deployed build; PASS/FAIL recorded in m12
out_of_scope: Real candidate PII in test runs — synthetic data + Tony-controlled inboxes/profiles only
Native mobile app (iOS/Android) — responsive web yes, native builds no
Billing / payments — internal tool, no invoicing module
scope_notes: LinkedIn IN scope, governed by policy engine (src/lib/linkedin-policy.ts); LinkedIn remains draft-gated and no channel has autonomous provider delivery authority in this release
Python fallback AUTHORIZED for agent-graph runtime if TS-native quality falls short (Tony, 2026-07-09)

Reply drafting = queue-only for this release: agents draft candidate replies, but every generated reply queues for named-human approval before provider dispatch. Legacy autopilot fields are compatibility metadata only.

WhatsApp channel (re-scope #2, Tony 2026-07-09): official API only (Meta Cloud API or Twilio) — unofficial libs (Baileys/whatsapp-web.js) banned, ToS/ban risk. Business-initiated messages use pre-approved templates; free-form only in 24h service window after candidate reply.

HUMAN-LIKENESS GATE (applies to ALL channels, hardest on WhatsApp): agent narration/status/meta messages ('thinking', 'processing', action-done notices, AI tells) NEVER reach the wire — internal events stay in events table. Outbound pipeline = compose → cache/hold buffer → AI-tell filter (banned-pattern list + humanizer rules + classifier) → dedupe cache (normalized-text hash per candidate) → human pacing (typing delays, quiet hours, one message per conversation at a time) → send. Fails gate → blocked + queued for Tony.
